name: Evaluating the Quality of Benchmark Datasets for Low-Resource Languages: A Case Study on Turkish
description: This benchmark evaluates the quality of benchmark datasets for low-resource languages, using Turkish as a case study. It does not test a downstream NLP task directly; instead, it assesses datasets against quality criteria such as linguistic suitability, cultural appropriateness, and technical correctness, often using both human and LLM-judge annotations.
evaluation_method: Criterion-based rubric scoring aggregated over benchmark datasets, including human and LLM-judge agreement and pass/fail quality rates
notes: This is a meta-benchmark about benchmark quality rather than a standard model capability benchmark. Because the task is evaluative and rubric-based, outputs are typically dataset quality summaries rather than a single canonical model score.
